hook: Your haircut in space needs clippers attached to a vacuum.
title: Your Haircut in Space Uses a Vacuum Hose
description:
On the space station, cut hair would float around the cabin and could get into equipment or eyes. So astronauts use clippers attached to a vacuum hose that sucks each hair straight in. Haircuts in space have been filmed.

#Shorts #Space #Astronaut
comment_prompt: Would you cut hair in space? Yes or no
